comment: Cool, another price hike and my liked songs still don't show up on album track lists. Paying more for less, great. Still here for my daily mix, but one more feature gets yanked and I'm out again.

$10.99 for no ads, offline downloads and casting is still a steal compared to everything else I pay for. The free tier is basically unusable so I'll always pay. Wish the app would stop shoving promoted stuff at me though.

Raising Premium to $10.99 while HiFi is still nowhere in sight. Tidal already gives me lossless and pays artists more per stream. I'm keeping Spotify for Connect and recs, but this just makes me move more stuff over.

It's a bit of a jump, but Spotify has been around $10 for a long time and the catalog is still the best bang for the buck. I'd want the ad-free part to stay solid though, since the free tier keeps getting more annoying.

Great, paying more for Premium and I still get ads in podcasts. They keep shoving podcasts at me on the home screen too. Just give me ad-free music without the podcast nonsense or I'm checking out YouTube Premium.

Price doesn't bother me much, I'm still on an older version anyway. What gets me is the layout changing under my feet. If that new home screen gets forced on me permanently I'm cancelling. Turn off auto updates and downgrade if you want it how it was.

Spotify raises the price and artists still get a fraction of a cent per stream. Where does the extra money go? Not to the people making the music. I'll stay out of habit, but this is exactly why I keep looking at services that pay artists more.

A buck more is fine if they actually add stuff. Nothing else has the radio and the playlist-with-friends stuff yet, so I'm not leaving. Still wish they'd show exact play counts, but stats.fm covers that for me.

Duo going to $14.99 still works out to about $7.50 each for us, which is fine. Ad-free with separate accounts is worth every penny. Only thing I hope is they don't force us onto some other plan when the notice comes.
Lol they raise the price and I'm already gone over the podcast-stuffed home screen. Not paying $16.99 for a family plan so podcasts can get shoved in my face every time I open it. Show me the music.

Price going up again and the UI is still a mess. Recommendations are my whole reason for staying and they keep getting staler. If the next redesign doesn't fix it I'm going to YouTube Music, no question.
Price going up, cool, and shuffle still isn't random. I pay for Premium and it still plays the same 20 songs from my 200-song playlist. Keep this up and Apple Music is looking real good.
Can't really afford $10.99 some months, and going up a dollar makes it harder. I'll probably drop back to free until money gets better. Free sucks but it's what I can do right now.

The price is whatever to me since I'm not even paying anymore, but the renew subscription pop-up still shows up every time I open the app. Reinstalled, cleared cache, nothing works. Anyone got a fix that actually sticks?
Doesn't change much for me since I'm on free anyway. I'm still tempted to get Premium so I can pick songs without ads, but $11 is more than I'd like. Free is tolerable until the ads get too much.

Spotify wants more money and still doesn't have lossless. Apple Music already gives me lossless and Spatial Audio for what I pay, so I'm seriously thinking about switching. Spotify Connect and Android Auto are the only reasons I'm still here.
I'm paying more for Premium and I still can't see my liked songs inside a playlist. The app keeps getting worse and they want more money? I'm switching back to Apple Music if this keeps going.

Another price hike and still no lossless on Spotify, while Tidal and Deezer already do hi-fi. I want lossless included without a fee or I'm not paying for it. At this point I'm only here for the playlists.

A buck more a month for the biggest library and Discover Weekly is fair to me. The recommendations repeat a lot lately, which is annoying, but I'm not going anywhere. Apple Music doesn't have a real equivalent to DW anyway.

$10.99 for the whole catalog is still a steal, honestly it should cost more. Artists get paid fractions of a cent per stream, so I'm glad to see the price move. Still cheaper than buying the albums on CD, so take the win.

Another price bump and they still haven't brought back the features they took away. Feels like they keep charging more for less. If the new UI sticks I'll keep voting with my wallet, which is what I've been saying for a while.

Student going from $4.99 to $5.99 is annoying, but it's still way cheaper than the regular plan and Hulu is still in the bundle. I'm not bailing yet. If it goes up again I'm going back to Apple Music.

Great, more money for an app that still has the feed cards I hate. I'm on a yearly plan and I still want to switch to Apple Music. There's no way to contact anyone about this either. Absolutely hate this update.

Paying more for an app that still breaks after every update? Downloaded songs still won't play offline for me. Support just says they're looking into it. The price going up doesn't feel great until the basics work.

Ha, more money for Premium and I still can't see liked songs inside a playlist, and enhance keeps stuffing recommended songs into my lists. I left over playlist sorting before. Not paying more until the basics work again.
Duo going up to $14.99 while the home screen is still TikTok garbage? Hard pass. Bring back the old UI or I'm done, I'll cancel and go to Apple Music or Tidal. Not paying more for this.
